/phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyi zin bris bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: /phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid kyi zin bris bzhugs so/

phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid nyams su len pa la gsum ste/ dang po sgom ma skyes pa skye bar byed pa sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor/ gnyis pa skyes pa nyams su len pa ngo sprod rnam gnyis/ gsum pa de bogs 'don pa la nyams len snang thog tu skyong ba'i man ngag go// dang po la gnyis thun mong dang*/ khyad par ro// thun mong la dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs dran par byas nas/ gnyis pa khyad par gyi sngon 'gro la bzhi ste/ dang po rang gi rgyud snod rung du bsgrub pa la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid ni dben pa'i gnas su/ rang stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi yan lag lngas gnas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang padma nyi zla'i gdan la/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang la brgyud pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la/ sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung mas bskor ba gsal btab/ yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi/ lha 'phags pa dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams la skyabs su mchi sogs skyabs 'gro nus tshad bya/ 'dod don du gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ mi rtag pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin par byin gyis rlobs/ mos gus dam bca' brtan par byin gyis rlobs/ bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byin gyis rlobs/ rten 'brel thabs la mkhas par byin gyis rlobs/ 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs/ bdag gi rgyud la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/

zhes brjod/ skyabs yul rang la bstim nas/ sems ma bcos par bzhag thun mtshams su bsngo ba byed/ gnyis pa rgyud gyi sdig sgrib dag par byed pa la rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor padma dkar po dang zla ba la rdo rje dkar po'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa zhig bsgoms pa'i thugs kar zla ba la hūm̐ las yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs las bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po bab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu'i dbyibs rgyud nas sku lus gang bar bsam/ de nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas nas/ gsol ba 'di ltar du 'debs/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ rang gi spyi gtsug tu zhugs pas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi lus gang nas/ yang yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso bos bdag la skyobs// zhes brjod nas rdo rje sems dpa' rang la bstim nas/ sems ma bcos par bzhag /ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba byed/ gsum pa rgyud la tshogs rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi khrid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su seng ge dang padma nyi zla'i steng du/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bzhugs par bsam la/

yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ maṇḍal dngos su med na lag pas bkod nas/ oṃ badzra bhū me āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi sogs tshom bdun ma la lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa gcal nas bkod pa dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod kha rje dbang thang*/ mthu nus pa rdzas yod byad yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad sems can gyi don du 'bul snyam pa byas nas/ bla ma yi dam bdag gi lus longs spyod maṇḍal dang bcas pa 'bul lo// thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas/ bdag la rtogs pa mchog tu gyur pa skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ de nas sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing sogs brjod nas/ tshogs rten rang la bstim nas/ sems ma bcos par bzhag thun mtshams su bsngo ba byed/ bzhi pa rang gi rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ rang gi spyi bor seng ge dang padma nyi zla sogs gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang du bsgoms pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsgom/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bla ma la thim pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsam la/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ maṇḍal sogs phul nas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa/ bla ma rin po che'i sku la gsol ba 'debs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma'i oṃ dang*/ āḥdang*/ hūm̐ gsum las 'od zer dkar po/ dmar po/ sngon po 'phros nas/ rang gi gnas gsum la thim/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/

bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ bla ma rang la bstim/ sems ma bcos pa la bzhag ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba byed/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rdzogs gnyis te/ dang po ni oṃ swa bhā wa'i don bsgoms nas/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma baṃ pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du/ rang gi rnam shes yi ge bam̐ smug nag gcig tu bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros phyi snod la phog gzhal yas khang du gyur/ nang bcud la phog yi dam gyi lha jo mo'i skur gyur/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo dar dmar po nam mkha' la 'phyar ba lta bu rtsa zhal khro zhal spyan gsum ma/ zhal bgrad pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ rna ltag g.yas su phag zhal gyi ngur sgra sgrog pas stong gsum zil gyis gnon pa/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi do shal byas pa/ gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga yod pa/ thal ba spangs pa'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas pad nyi ro'i gdan gyi steng du gar thabs ling nge bzhugs par bsgoms pa'i thugs kha'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par bstim/ yang bam̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan par bsam/ thugs kar yi ge bam̐ gyi mtha' mar/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bāai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes g.yon bskor du 'khor ba la dmigs te bzlas nas/ thun bsdu khar spyi bo dang rkang mthil nas snying gar bam̐ la bsdus nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas sems ma bcos par bzhag ldang ba'i dus su bsngo ba byed/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la dmigs bcas dang dmigs med do// dmigs bcas la gsum ste/

dang po bca' ba lus kyi gnad ni/ rnam snang gi chos bdun legs par bcas la/ gnyis pa dmigs pa sems kyi gnad ni/ zhi gnas kyi don du/ dngos su shing bu dang rde'u la sems bzung ba dang*/ smin mtshams su me tog dmar po zhig bsam la sems bzung ba dang*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar thub pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa zhig bsam la sems bzung ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gser gyi lhun po lta bu'i sku 'dis ni// 'jig rten gsum po kun nas snang bar byed// dmigs pa de la gang gi sems 'dzin pa// byang chub sems dpa' de mnyam bzhag ces bya/ zhes dang*/ tilli pas/ lta stangs dang ni sems 'dzin du ma yis// rig pa ngang la mi gnas bar du gcun// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// gsum pa nyams len dus kyi gnad ni/ lus ngag yid gsum tshogs pa gcig pa'i ngang nas/ spang skam la phur pa btab pa'am/ chu bcad pa'i rang 'thag gam/ sbrang ma gar spyin la 'byar ba bzhin du g.yo 'gul med par/ 'jig rten gyi bya byed thams cad yal bar dor nas/ bar mtshams med par nyams su blangs pas/ zhi lhag skye ste/ zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes bya ste// thog mar zhi gnas btsal bya de yang ni// 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// ces so// dmigs med la yang gsum ste/ dang por gzhi lta bas gtan la 'bebs pa ni lta ba khas len yid byed thams cad dang bral bar rtogs nas/ gnyis pa bsgom pas nyams su len pa ni/ skyong thabs bdun dang*/ yid la mi byed pa bcu gcig go// skyong thabs la ni/ yid la mi byed par skyong ba/ yod med yin min brtag dpyad bzang ngan spang blang spros pa gang yang yid la mi byed do// tilli pas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i don// 'bras bu gang la yang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// zhes dang*/ yid la mi byed pas ni khams gsum gang du yang 'dre bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// dran pa ma yengs par skyong ba ni/

spyod lam gang la yang*/ rkyen bzang ngan ci byung yang ma yengs pa gal che ste/ dran pa yengs med ma shes na// mi sgom pa la bya thabs med// ces pa dang*/ chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la// ma yengs pa yi dran pa gces// zhes dang*/ dran pa rgyun chad med pa ni// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gzhung lam yin// zhes dang*/ rje 'jig rten mgon pos/ dran pa dran pa bu kun dran pa rab la sgom rab// ces gsungs so// brtson 'grus chen pos skyong ba ni/ snyom las dang le lo med par rtse gcig pa'i ngang nas/ glang po'i 'gros sam/ pi wang gi rgyud bzhin du sgom ste/ 'jig rten mgon pos/ brtson 'grus chen pos go ba de// dran pa rgyun chad med pa yin// go ba 'dzol na phung bar mchis// zhes gsungs so// sgrim lhod kyi mtha' dang bral bar skyong ba ni/ shes pa lhod la gar song cha med pa phub ma zhabs kyi chu bzhin du ma song bar/ sgrim pa 'jur drag pa'i skud pa lta bur ma song bar bya ste/ sa ra has/ bram zes skud pa 'khal ba bzhin// so ma ma bcos lhug par zhog /'jur bus bcings pa'i sems nyid 'di// glod na grol bar the tshom med// ces gsungs so// mtho dman gyi bsam blo spangs te skyong ba ni/ mtho ba sangs rgyas dang dma' ba sems can sogs gang yang bsam blo mi bya ste/ tilli pas/ blo yi chos kyis blo 'das don mi mthong*// byas pa'i chos kyis byar med don mi rtogs// blo 'das byar med don de rtogs 'dod na// rang sems rtsa ba chod la rig pa gcer bur zhog /rtog pa dri ma'i chu de dwangs su chug /ces gsungs so// ma bcos par skyong ba ni/ da ltar gyi shes pa 'di ka las gzhan pa'i rtog pa bzang ngan gang la yang bcos bsgyur mi bya ste/ ma bcos pa ni 'phags pa kun gyi lam// bcos ma'i stobs kyis 'phags lam thob mi srid// ces dang*/ rgyud las/ ma bcos gnyug ma'i zas zhig zos gyur na// grub mtha' ma lus kun kyang tshim par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// sgom med kyi don la skyong ba ni/

gsang 'dus las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med// bsgom par bya ba sgom pa min// de ltar dngos po dngos med pas// sgom pa dmigs su med pa'o// zhes dang*/ kyai rdo rje las/ sgom med sgom pa po yang med// lha dang sngags kyang yod ma yin// spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin la// lha dang sngags ni yang dag gnas// zhes gsungs pas skyong thabs bdun no// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yid la mi byed cing*/ de yi rang bzhin gzugs sogs lnga chos drug gi rang bzhin yid la mi byed pas na yid la mi byed pa bcu gcig go// shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum du ma song ba bya zhing*/ des lhag mthong ngo sprod pa'o// gsum pa spyod pas bogs 'don pa/ nyams len snang thog tu skyong ba'i man ngag ces pa la/ gang shar ngos 'dzin lta ba'i gnad// de la ma yengs sgom pa'i gnad// dran pa ro snyoms spyod pa'i gnad// klong du gyur pa 'bras bu'i gnad// ces pas/ gang shar gyi steng du bsal bzhag med par blta/ ma yengs par bsgom/ bzang ngan thams cad la dga' sdug mi byed pa'o// 'bras bu de rang yin te/ rje 'jig rten mgon po'i zhal nas/ phyag rgya chen po bya ba de// rang gi rig pa 'di nyid yin// de la ma yengs skyong ba de// gnyug ma chos skur go ba yin// phyag rgya chen po'i bogs 'don de// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus yin// snang srid chos skur go ba de// phyag rgya chen po'i go ba yin// rnam rtog chos skur rtogs pa de// phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yin// 'khor 'das bde skyid 'byung ba de// phyag rgya chen po'i yon tan yin// sku gsum 'gro don byed pa de// phyag rgya chen po'i phrin las yin// zhes gsungs pas/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum rdzogs pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i lam cha lag dang bcas pa rdzogs pa'o// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi zin bris/ 'dan ma bsam grub kyis zhus pa'i ngor/
shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang pos/ 'bri gung 'og min gyi gnas su bkod pa'o// dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig /
